description: This Java source file defines an Android Service named AdvertiserService that manages Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) advertising independently of the main app. It handles starting and stopping BLE advertising, manages advertising timeouts, and broadcasts failure states.

classes.name: AdvertiserService
classes.description: An Android Service class managing BLE advertising, including initialization, start, stop, timeout handling, and broadcasting status/failure messages.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the service, sets running flag, starts advertising, and sets up timeout.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Stops advertising, removes callbacks, and updates running flag during service shutdown.

methods.name: onBind
methods.description: Returns null, indicating this is a started service, not a bound service.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Sets up BluetoothLeAdvertiser if available; shows Toast error if Bluetooth is not available.

methods.name: setTimeout
methods.description: Sets a delayed runnable to stop advertising after 10 minutes.

methods.name: startAdvertising
methods.description: Configures and initiates BLE advertising with specific settings and data.

methods.name: stopAdvertising
methods.description: Stops BLE advertising and clears callback.

methods.name: buildAdvertiseData
methods.description: Creates AdvertiseData including service UUID and device name.

methods.name: buildAdvertiseSettings
methods.description: Creates AdvertiseSettings using low power mode and no timeout.

methods.name: sendFailureIntent
methods.description: Broadcasts an intent indicating advertising failure with error code.
